app.title: ThinkRush VR
welcome.heading: Welcome to ThinkRush
welcome.body1: Stay seated and use your hands.
welcome.body2: Solve the puzzle on the table.
move.drop: Pinch your pick and DROP it on the tray.
move.flip: Pinch your pick and FLIP it over.
move.lift: Pinch your pick and LIFT it above your head.
move.show: Pinch your pick and SHOW it to RUSH.
pattern.drop: Pinch the missing piece and DROP it in the gap.
object.drop: Pinch the missing piece, TURN it to fit and DROP it in the gap.
object.turn: Right piece! TURN it until it fits the gap.
puzzle.instructionsOrbs: Pick the orb with the right answer.
puzzle.wrongPick: Wrong pick! This one is lost.
pause.heading: Paused
pause.body: Turn your palm up again, or press Resume, to carry on.
welcome.pauseHint: Turn a palm up any time to pause.
perf.line: {fps} fps (display {hz} Hz), slowest frame {worst} ms, {late} late, {calls} draws, {triangles}k triangles
tour.hello: Hi, I'm RUSH, your puzzle partner.
tour.grab: Pinch an object on the table and pick it up.
tour.orb: Point at the orb with the right answer, then pinch.
tour.clockDetail: I shrink and turn red as time runs out, and the music speeds up.
tour.pauseDetail: Turn a palm up and hold it to pause.
tour.done: You're ready! Pick a world to play.
